scope: Move Tune MTP to conversation header. No RAM change in diff. Single-user desktop app.

findings.title: Surface tuning errors when launched with inspector closed
findings.scenario: Ready compatible model and prepared head; inspector closed by default; new header calls tuneMTP; engine sends error or unreadable reply.
findings.observed: mtpError is set; engine remains ready; inspector stays closed; button returns to idle label and generic tooltip. The only UI reading mtpError is GenerationInspector, so the failure is invisible. Successful result rows also remain hidden.
findings.smallest_fix: Open the inspector when starting from the header, or display terminal tuning feedback next to this button. Add a regression for the new entry path.
findings.verification_limit: Calls the exact production StudioModel entry used by the button and renders actual StudioView. No automated physical click on SwiftUI button.

checks.warnings: Existing SwiftMath deprecations/linker paths and non-fatal CoreGraphics PDF fixture diagnostic
